intro: Completed work, methods and research direction.

thoughts.title: Research completed
thoughts.summary: Perovskite/polymer nanocomposites translated into a self-powered UV-sensing device.
thoughts.label: Completed study
thoughts.text: My published project followed a functional material from synthesis and characterisation through device fabrication and UV-sensing evaluation.
thoughts.note: I am most interested when material behaviour can be connected to a measurable device response.

thoughts.title: Methods I can evidence
thoughts.summary: Materials preparation, characterisation, device fabrication, analysis and scientific communication.
thoughts.label: Evidence-based skills
thoughts.text: The project gives me a concrete basis for discussing nanocomposite preparation, structural and spectroscopic characterisation, device fabrication, data interpretation and research communication.
thoughts.note: I am strengthening Python and computational skills so they can support future materials work rather than sit separately from it.

thoughts.title: Research direction
thoughts.summary: Materials, interfaces, sensing, semiconductors and data-informed experimentation.
thoughts.label: Direction
thoughts.text: I am exploring research directions where experimental materials work can connect with computation, sensing, semiconductor systems and practical technological constraints.
thoughts.note: Build depth from evidence first; add new directions only as the skills and projects become real.
